name: U DON'T GET IT
source:
What happens when the person you expected to guide you through university acts like you don't even exist?

Entering campus was supposed to be a fresh start, but instead, you are met with cold indifference. Your assigned guide—the very person tied to your expectations—ignores your presence entirely, failing to fulfill his duty and leaving you in a web of unanswered questions.

Is it mere coldness, or is there something far more unsettling hidden beneath the surface?

[From [url=https://vhan-5.itch.io/u-dont-get-it]itch.io[/url]]
